Standard: Ventilation airflow of the occupied spaces and equipment compartments during normal system operating conditions is IAW MIL-E-18927, Airflow paragraph. Fresh air that has not been recirculated is introduced into occupied compartments by the ECS. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis to verify that the ECS meets the minimum ventilation airflow rates under normal operating conditions throughout the flight envelope. Prior to entering operational test or operations, verify the standard by the following method(s): Test.
  (1) Flight test: Conduct flight testing to verify the ECS meets the minimum ventilation airflow rates under normal operating conditions throughout the flight envelope.
